title: Guilty on Investors, Not Guilty on Patients: The Elizabeth Holmes Verdict

lines.say: January third, two thousand twenty-two. The jury in the Elizabeth Holmes trial fills out its verdict form.
lines.show: January 3, 2022. The jury in the Elizabeth Holmes trial fills out its verdict form.

lines.say: Count one, conspiracy to defraud Theranos investors. Guilty.
Count two, conspiracy to defraud Theranos patients. Not guilty.
Three more investor counts: guilty. Every patient count that reached the jury: not guilty. On three counts, it could not agree.
So her convictions are about one thing: what she told the people who funded Theranos.
The sentence: eleven years and three months, later cut to one hundred twenty-three months.
lines.show: The sentence: 11 years and 3 months, later cut to 123 months.

lines.say: Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
